text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice of the following resignations from the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: · Karima Ewig - November 16, 2020 · Michael Miceli - November 26, 2020 Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office and Equity, Diversity, and Human Rights in the People and Equity Office are working on a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration. If you have any questions about this update, please contact the Public Appointments Secretariat at appoint@toronto.ca or 416-397-0088.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
